corrections.reason: The word ስብከ (molten/cast image, in ስብከ ላህም 'molten calf') is clearly printed between በኮሬብ and ላህም in the image but was omitted in Draft Pass 1.
Classical Ge'ez verb with 3rd person masculine plural object suffix requires 7th-order ኦ (ያወፅኦሙ ለአጋንንት), matching the printed glyph.
The printed glyph is 6th-order ን (እዝን 'ear/fluid'), matching the subsequent definite form እዝኑ.
Amharic compound preposition ከነ- (ከነቅጠሉ 'with its leaves') is printed with 1st-order ከ.
Amharic demonstrative ከዚህ ends with 6th-order ህ, which was misread as 1st-order ሀ.
Canonical Ge'ez plural verb ወየኃሥሡ (agreeing with እምከ ወአኃዊከ ይቀውሙ ... ይትናገሩከ) has the 2nd-order ሡ stroke on the second ሥ.
